name: napi-vm
description: A sandboxed JavaScript virtual machine built from scratch in Rust with NAPI bindings for Node.js

scripts.lint: bun run lint:rust && bun run lint:ts
scripts.check:generated: bun run build:all && git diff --exit-code -- index.js index.mjs index.d.ts
scripts.test: bun test ./tests --path-ignore-patterns "**/{node,wasm}/**" && npm run test:node && node --test tests/wasm/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:wasm: npm run playground:build && npm run lint:playground && node --test tests/wasm/*.test.mjs
scripts.plugins:build:rust: cargo build -p napi-vm-plugin-protocol -p napi-vm-plugin-sdk -p napi-vm-plugin-host -p napi-vm-plugin-conformance -p trusted-greeter-rust -p trusted-counter-rust -p trusted-host-rust
scripts.plugins:build: npm run plugins:build:ts && npm run plugins:build:rust
scripts.plugins:test:rust: cargo test -p napi-vm-plugin-protocol -p napi-vm-plugin-sdk -p napi-vm-plugin-host -p napi-vm-plugin-conformance -p trusted-greeter-rust -p trusted-counter-rust -p trusted-host-rust
scripts.plugins:check: npm run plugins:check-generated && npm run plugins:check-assets && npm run plugins:build && npm run plugins:typecheck && npm run plugins:lint && npm run plugins:test:node && npm run plugins:test:bun && npm run plugins:test:rust && npm run plugins:test:interop && npm run plugins:test:rust-interop && npm run plugins:test:packaged && npm run plugins:test:consumers && npm run plugins:test:rust-consumer
scripts.plugins:lint: node tools/plugins/check-syntax.mjs && cargo fmt -p napi-vm-plugin-protocol -p napi-vm-plugin-sdk -p napi-vm-plugin-host -p napi-vm-plugin-conformance -p trusted-greeter-rust -p trusted-counter-rust -p trusted-host-rust -- --check && cargo clippy -p napi-vm-plugin-protocol -p napi-vm-plugin-sdk -p napi-vm-plugin-host -p napi-vm-plugin-conformance -p trusted-greeter-rust -p trusted-counter-rust -p trusted-host-rust --all-targets -- -D warnings

author: nglmercer
